judge.rationale: Agreement is strong because all four primary Node 14 hypotheses comparably invoke PTMA, HNRNPA2B1-mediated RNA processing, RPLP0-linked translation, TUBB4B-associated mitotic machinery, and Ki-67 proliferation, while MYC/E2F and related upstream framing appear only in some answers, leaving limited but meaningful differences and no mandatory ceiling below 8.
